launchSite.name: Launch Canada
launchSite.notes: Rail length is the LCRA-provided 18.5 ft 1515 rail (DTEG R4 11.1.1). Set altitudeMsl/latitude for your launch site; density at deployment depends on it.

recovery.openingForceCoefficientSource: Knacke, Parachute Recovery Systems Design Manual, table 5-1 (infinite-mass Cx); team doc UTAT-ROC-LIQ-REC-001
recovery.inflationNotes: Fill constant n and exponent j are assumptions for the finite-mass estimate (fill time = n*D0/v). Lower n / lower j are more conservative. Calibrate from deployment test data.
recovery.maxLandingEnergyNote: Per independently landing section; common high-power practice (e.g. IREC). Set your competition's value.

structures.flutterNotes: NACA TN 4197 screening estimate (K = 39.3/14.696; Peak of Flight #615 correction of the 1.337 form). flutterMinMargin = flutter speed / airspeed required along the whole flight; a team choice, not a Launch Canada rule. Shear moduli are typical in-plane values: replace them with your laminate's data.

fiberglass|g10|g-10|fr4|fr-4.source: typical G10/FR4 in-plane shear modulus (~425 ksi)

carbon.source: typical 0/90 woven carbon/epoxy in-plane shear modulus; quasi-isotropic layups are ~15-17 GPa

plywood|birch.source: typical aircraft birch plywood; highly variable
